main.*: {{apichanges|4.4.0|prev=3.4.3|next=4.4.1}} ==Summary== * The client now supports a new _Cata suffix for loading [[TOC_format#Multiple_client_flavors|client-specific TOC files]]. * The client now supports comma-delimited Interface versions, allowing addons to declare a TOC file as being compatible with multiple versions or flavors of the game at once. * The {{api|t=a|C_ChatInfo.SendAddonMessage}} now more aggressively throttles all addon traffic on a per-prefix level, and returns an enum result code instead of a boolean when a message is unable to be queued for transmission. See the [[Patch 10.2.7/API changes#Addon messaging changes|Patch 10.2.7 addon messaging changes]] for more details. ==Resources== * TOC: 40400 * Diffs: [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/compare/3.4.3..4.4.0 wow-ui-source], [https://github.com/Ketho/BlizzardInterfaceResources/compare/3.4.3..4.4.0 BlizzardInterfaceResources] ==Breaking changes== * The behavior of the legacy _Classic TOC suffix has changed. ** TOC files with this suffix now load on all Classic client flavors. Previously, they would only load on [[World of Warcraft: Classic|Classic Era]]. ** AddOns which require a TOC file only load on Classic Era should instead use the _Vanilla suffix.
